t: This card links $(l:rftoolsbase:powerstorage/dimensionalcell)Dimensional Cells$(/l) together. A new card starts unlinked. Insert it into a Dimensional Cell to create or copy a link.
此卡片用于链接$(l:rftoolsbase:powerstorage/dimensionalcell)维度能量单元$(/l)。新卡片默认未链接，将其插入维度能量单元即可创建或复制链接。
Use the linked card on other Dimensional Cells to join them to the same remote storage network.
在其他维度细胞上使用已链接的卡片，即可将其加入同一远程存储网络。
